data.narrative:
Multiply Labs is a Series A-stage biotech company founded by Fred Parietti and Alice Melocchi that has raised $41M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 3 public peers in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private companies including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Only one valuation method yielded sufficient data for triangulation. The stage-progression approach, applicable to early-stage private companies, uses the $85M total-raised proxy as a baseline and applies a 2.0x multiplier typical for Series A progression to the next funding stage, implying a valuation of $170M. The peer-median method proved inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow biotech peer set—only one adjacent-stage peer exists among the filtered universe. Public-comp anchoring, while supportable in theory (the sector median P/S is 6.2x across the three public tickers), cannot be applied absent the target's revenue data, which private companies typically do not disclose.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $144M to $195M, with a median estimate of $170M. This range reflects the single applicable method and carries material uncertainty around comparable selection and the target's actual revenue profile, which would materially alter any revenue-multiple analysis.
